 Ilia Topuria Once Faced Threats From Tagir Ulanbekov and Usman Nurmagomedov: “When We Meet, Your Teeth Will Be Straightened Out”
 By Subham 
 Nov 14, 2026 Nov 14, 2026 
 Home 
 › 
 MMA News 
 › 
 Ilia Topuria Once Faced Threats From Tagir Ulanbekov and Usman Nurmagomedov: “When We Meet, Your Teeth Will Be Straightened Out” 
 Old tweets have resurfaced, revealing that UFC flyweight contender Tagir Ulanbekov, who was also involved in the attack on Merab Dvalishvili and his friend Saba Lazishvili on Wednesday, had threatened to attack Ilia Topuria in 2024.
 Usman Nurmagomedov, Tagir Ulanbekov, and several other Russian and Dagestani fighters attacked Merab and Saba in a hotel lobby in Abu Dhabi. During the melee, Saba knocked down Tagir.
 🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨📽️
“ بالفديو البطيء لحظة هجوم عثمان على 
ميراب دفاليشفيلي مقطع كامل 🤯🤯🔥 ” pic.twitter.com/Z6iDV214vB 
— دحوم UFC (@DhomUFC) November 11, 2026 
 Following the incident, Usman and seven others have reportedly been sentenced to six months in prison, heavily fined, and will be deported after serving their sentences. Meanwhile, Merab and Saba were also detained but later released after being fined 50,000 AED each.
 READ MORE:   Jorge Masvidal Says He's Put $200,000 on Josh Hokit ... With $1 Million Coming Back If He Wins Now, old tweets have resurfaced, which show Tagir and Usman threatening Ilia Topuria.
 In 2024, during an online back-and-forth with “El Matador,” Tagir quipped:
 “Ilia, save up your money and find a good dentist. When we meet, your teeth will be straightened out.”
 Meanwhile, Usman Nurmagomedov had added:
 “I hope you have the same energy when we face each other.”
 Check out Tagir Ulanbekov and Usman Nurmagomedov’s comments below: 
 🔙 Usman Nurmagomedov ve Merab’a saldıran ekipte yer alan Tagir Ulanbekov, 2024 yılında gördükleri yerde Ilia Topuria’ya da saldıracaklarını söylemişlerdi:
Usman Nurmagomedov: ‘’Umarım karşılaştığımızda da aynı enerjiye sahip olursun.’’
Tagir Ulanbekov: ‘’Ilia, paranı biriktir… pic.twitter.com/ASSIe0rkhZ 
— Kırmızı Köşe (@KirmiziKoseMMA) November 14, 2026 
 Ilia Topuria Blasts “bunch of mediocre” individuals Usman and team for attacking Merab
 Ilia Topuria was among the first to inform fans about Wednesday’s altercation and the detention of Usman Nurmagomedov and his team. In an X post, the former UFC two-division champion blasted the Russian fighters for their actions, labeling them as a bunch of absolute cowards for jumping “The Machine” and Saba Lazishvili .
 “And these are the same people who dare to preach about humility and respect? What a disgrace. A bunch of absolute cowards. I always thought you were a bunch of mediocre individuals. Now you’ve removed every last doubt. Honor, respect, and humility aren’t words you preach. They’re values you live by. And you’ve shown none of them.”
 Check out Ilia Topuria’s comments below: 
 Usman has reportedly been detained, along with the cowards who were with him.
And these are the same people who dare to preach about humility and respect? What a disgrace. A bunch of absolute cowards.
